event: The other person invites the camera wearer to sit down.

sounding_object.description: A man wearing a light blue short-sleeved polo shirt, khaki shorts, and white sneakers. He has short brown hair and is wearing glasses. He also has wired earbuds in, with the wire running down his shirt. He is holding a black smartphone in his right hand.

facing_object.description: The direction the camera is pointing.

question: Imagine you are the camera wearer, when the speech topic "inviting to sit down" comes up, relative to where you are facing, where is the other person : left, right, or back? If the object is generally to your left and facing it requires turning less than 120 degrees left, choose 'left'. If the object is generally to your right and facing it requires turning less than 120 degrees right, choose 'right'. If the object is generally behind you and facing it requires turning 120 degrees or more, choose 'back'.
